source_access: Original paths are provenance only; read only frozen files explicitly listed in workspace.
preconditions: Native Dex3 mesh and checkpoint four-point control; stable low-table reach, fresh stereo and reliable visible edges rather than shadow-corrupted fits.
principle: After measured reachable approach and whole-hand clearance, establish achieved opposition before gradual closure. An ambiguous first probe/hold does not prove retention; another small observed probe and separate hold can resolve co-motion before continued retained lift.
exit_evidence: Consult the referenced public final stereo pair and phase-specific public skill; host certification is separate from what each image proves.
range_scope: whole successful episode, not a claim that every action is an effective atomic skill

control_contract.timing: 50Hz tracker/200Hz MuJoCo; physics paused for reasoning

when_not_to_use: No copied coordinates/closure values, general gait, loaded walking or post-terminal dwell. Keep failed probes and frame-fit ambiguities as counterexamples.
unverified: No new cross-task outcome, loaded locomotion or true handover established by this index.
